  - server_name: "matrix.org"

enable_search: true

account:

  displayname_change_allowed: true
upstream_oauth2:
  providers:
    - id: 01KFNXQM0TWGX125SAXYABC3CR
      human_name: Pocket-ID
      issuer: https://id.albdev.cloud
      client_id: 823e89c4-5064-4347-b68d-b5d52d8f6778
      client_secret: ${MATRIX_CLIENT_SECRET}
      userinfo_endpoint: https://id.albdev.cloud/api/oidc/userinfo
      authorization_endpoint: https://id.albdev.cloud/authorize
      token_endpoint: https://id.albdev.cloud/api/oidc/token
      jwks_uri: https://id.albdev.cloud/.well-known/jwks.json
      token_endpoint_auth_method: client_secret_post
      scope: "openid email profile"
      discovery_mode: oidc
      pkce_method: auto
      claims_imports:
        localpart:
          action: require
          template: "{{ user.preferred_username }}"
          on_conflict: replace
        displayname:
          action: suggest
          template: "{{ user.name }}"
        email:
          action: suggest
          template: "{{ user.email }}"

/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-charts-immich-imm.name: immich-machine-learning
/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-labs-charts-immich-imm.doc:
Immich is a self-hosted photo and video backup solution.

For immich, there are multiple helm deployments:

  • immich-web
  • immich-server
  • immich-typesense
  • immich-machine-learning (this one)
  • immich-microservices

For redis and postgres, there are multiple helm charts:

  • Redis: app-template/redis, bitnami/redis
  • PostgreSQL: operator cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg, bitnami bitnami/postgresql
